frase_gancho.texto: Who they are, where they come from and how they have resisted.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: This hall is about identity: how Indigenous peoples recognize themselves, what stories they tell about themselves and how they have resisted the passing of time. It has no display cases full of objects, but large murals: Indigenous people of Oaxaca, a procession carrying the Virgin of Juquila along the road, and a look at the spiritual thought of the Maya of the Yucatán Peninsula. They are paintings made in 1964, when the museum opened, that sought to show living peoples. Look at them as an open question: who tells the story of a people, and how do they tell it?
